source.description:
PROBLEM: Agent guidance is split across three layers — tool-injected primes (bd, gitnexus, sp), static CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md in each repo, and per-project overlays — with no reconciliation mechanism between them. Result:
1. Vertical drift: parent CLAUDE.md (~/dev/CLAUDE.md) and project CLAUDE.md (specialists/, xtrm-tools/) diverge silently. Updates land in one place, not the others.
2. Horizontal drift: tool-injected primes evolve with each tool version (new flags, new commands), but static CLAUDE.md repeats older versions and lies.
3. Knowledge loss: agents repeatedly forget gotchas — `bd create --parent <epic-id>` for `.N` child auto-naming was missing in the bd reference (this session, the user had to point it out before I correctly used --parent for the KPI epic); memory gate ack was a surprise mid-session; `sp merge` file-based limitation surprised me when manual fallback was needed; `bd query` and `bd dep relate` exist but aren't loud enough to be defaults.

SUCCESS: After all 4 children PASS:
- A canonical "Common pitfalls / gotchas" section exists with at minimum 10 captured patterns, version-pinned.
- Shared CLAUDE.md content lives in xtrm-tools/templates/claude-md-fragments/ as managed fragments wrapped with sentinel markers.
- An `xt claude-sync` (or `xt init --reconcile-claude`) command exists: reports drift, --apply overwrites managed sections only.
- `xt doctor` / `sp doctor` reports CLAUDE.md fragment drift alongside skill/specialist/hook checks.
- Each tool's prime emits a short, version-pinned "hot tips" section at session start (bd, sp, gitnexus).

SCOPE: see children. .1 inventory + pitfalls capture; .2 sentinel mechanism + sync script; .3 doctor wiring; .4 tool-injected hot-tips.

NON_GOALS: No restructuring of the existing CLAUDE.md beyond what fragmentation requires. No deletion of project-specific overlay content. No new CLI commands beyond claude-sync. No automatic enforcement (always opt-in: --apply, --accept-overwrite). No onboarding skill in this epic — separate follow-up if needed after .4.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Sentinel boundaries must NEVER clobber non-managed prose; --apply requires --accept-overwrite or equivalent confirmation flag.
- Fragments must be tool-version-aware: if bd ships v2.0 with new flags, the fragment increments and triggers drift detection.
- Hot tips and fragments cannot duplicate each other — fragments are stable workflow knowledge; hot tips are version-pinned current-release callouts.
- Mirror the canonical sync pattern from `sp init --sync-defaults` (already proven for .specialists/default/).
- Bundle fragments into sp itself (or ship via xtrm-tools install path) so even xtrm-tools-less projects get them via sp init.

VALIDATION:
- After all 4 children: dispatch a fresh agent in a clean repo; verify it knows about --parent, memory gate, sp merge limitation, dep relate, query within first 3 turns of relevant work.
- xt doctor reports CLAUDE.md fragments status alongside other checks.
- xt claude-sync --check reports drift on a deliberately stale CLAUDE.md.
- Hot tips visible in session-start banner; reflect current tool version.

OUTPUT: 4 merged children + sp epic merge of this epic.

source.description:
PROBLEM: jhhu4.4 implemented version-pinned hot tips for sp's session-start hook (specialists e6176e29 + c421d0fd). bd's session-start surface is bd prime (the bd binary) and gitnexus's is its own hook — both are external/upstream and require PRs to those projects.

SUCCESS:
- bd prime emits a 'Hot Tips' subsection with ≤6 entries pinned to current bd version. Examples (from jhhu4.4):
  - bd create --parent <epic-id> auto-assigns .N
  - bd kv set 'memory-acked:<id>' before bd close
  - bd dep relate <a> <b> for non-blocking links
  - bd defer <id> +<duration> for hidden deferrals
  - bd query 'status=in_progress AND assignee=me' for SQL filters
- gitnexus session-start (or equivalent surface; current gitnexus-hook.cjs is PostToolUse-only — needs a SessionStart sibling) emits ≤3 hot tips:
  - gitnexus_impact BEFORE editing any symbol
  - gitnexus_detect_changes BEFORE every commit
  - gitnexus_rename for safe multi-file renames

SCOPE:
- Upstream beads project: bd prime output formatting
- Upstream gitnexus project: SessionStart hook (likely a new file; existing hook is PostToolUse)

NON_GOALS:
- No changes inside this repo — both surfaces live upstream.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Same constraints as jhhu4.4: ≤6 lines, ≤80 chars/entry, version-pinned header.
- Hot tips additive — must not displace existing prime content.

VALIDATION:
- After upstream releases land + 'npm i -g @beads/cli' (or equivalent), bd prime in any repo shows the Hot Tips block.
- Same for gitnexus.

OUTPUT: Two upstream PRs (one to beads, one to gitnexus). May be deferred indefinitely if upstream maintainers don't accept the pattern; that is acceptable since sp side already provides the version-pinned hot-tips functionality for the most-frequent agent friction surface.
